name: email_security
description: Inbound email security gateway (ADR 0028). v1 scope: the bare-provider path -- Gmail personal accounts over IMAP IDLE using app-password auth -- plus MIME parsing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification, and the measured static signals from the D9 measurement campaign. Attachment detonation reuses the existing malware_detection sandbox; link detonation is a separate network-enabled engine. The MTA-relay path for owned domains is a later stage and is NOT built here. Outlook.com personal accounts are deliberately deferred (no app-password equivalent; XOAUTH2 would require a registered OAuth app).
